property.name: x_tema_isb.api_base_url
property.description: Base URL for the Innovation Sandbox on AWS API Gateway (e.g., https://abc123.execute-api.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/prod)

property.name: x_tema_isb.api_client_id
property.description: OAuth Client ID for ISB API authentication

property.name: x_tema_isb.api_client_secret
property.description: OAuth Client Secret for ISB API authentication (encrypted)

property.name: x_tema_isb.auth_token_cache
property.description: Cached ISB API auth token (auto-managed by ISBApiClient)

property.name: x_tema_isb.auth_token_expiry
property.description: Cached ISB API auth token expiry timestamp (auto-managed)

property.name: x_tema_isb.idc_lambda_api_url
property.description: API Gateway URL for the IDC User Group Manager Lambda (e.g., https://xyz789.execute-api.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/prod)

property.name: x_tema_isb.idc_api_key
property.description: API Key for the IDC User Group Manager Lambda endpoint (encrypted)

property.name: x_tema_isb.identity_store_id
property.description: IAM Identity Center Identity Store ID (e.g., d-1234567890)

property.name: x_tema_isb.lambda_start_api_url
property.description: API Gateway URL for the Lambda start/stop script

property.name: x_tema_isb.lambda_api_key
property.description: API Key for the Lambda start/stop script endpoint (encrypted)

property.name: x_tema_isb.s3_bucket_name
property.description: S3 bucket name for sandbox configuration storage
